items.headline: Baleba returns in behind-closed-doors friendly as recovery progresses
items.summary: Carlos Baleba played his first minutes for Manchester United in a behind-closed-doors match against Lausanne-Sport, continuing recovery from ankle injury ahead of Tottenham trip.

items.headline: De Ligt returns as Carrick prepares for Tottenham without Rashford and Mainoo
items.summary: Matthijs de Ligt returned in friendly; Marcus Rashford, Kobbie Mainoo, Patrick Dorgu and Noussair Mazraoui remain concerns ahead of October 10 Tottenham match.

items.headline: United reportedly planning €70m January bid for Tottenham defender van de Ven
items.summary: Manchester United preparing €70 million (£58m) offer for Tottenham centre-back Micky van de Ven in January transfer window, emerging as frontrunners.
